question: Why did NYC yellow taxi trips drop on Thursday 28 Nov 2024 compared with the surrounding weeks?

table_notes.whybot.yellow_daily: Zetaris SchemaStore view (cached) over NY_TAXI.yellow_taxi (real NYC TLC yellow trips): one row per day 2024-04-01..2025-02-28. trip_date DATE, trips = trip count, avg_total_amount = mean total_amount USD per trip, avg_trip_distance = mean miles. Fast. Use for the metric, weekday baselines and fare/distance mix. Join key: trip_date (DATE). It has no d_date_sk or other surrogate key.
table_notes.whybot.nyc_weather_daily: Zetaris view over NOAA GHCN-Daily, Central Park station USW00094728 (real, CC0): obs_date DATE (2024-01-01..2025-02-05), prcp_mm (mm), snow_mm (mm snowfall), tmax_c, tmin_c (deg C). Join key: obs_date = whybot.yellow_daily.trip_date.
table_notes.whybot.us_holidays: Zetaris view over Nager.Date REST (real US holidays 2024-2025): holiday_date DATE, holiday_name, is_national (true = federal, false = state-only). The authoritative holiday source. Join key: holiday_date = whybot.yellow_daily.trip_date (LEFT JOIN from yellow_daily: days that are not holidays have no row).
table_notes.TPCDS_DB.date_dim: TPC-DS calendar (full name TPCDS_DB.date_dim, not whybot.date_dim): d_date DATE, d_day_name, d_dow (0=Sunday, 1=Monday .. 6=Saturday; never 7: Spark dayofweek() is the 1=Sunday..7=Saturday one), d_weekend ('Y' on Fri and Sat in this build), d_holiday ('Y'/'N'). d_holiday is SYNTHETIC and unreliable; use it only to flag data-quality disagreements with whybot.us_holidays. Use d_day_name for weekdays. Join key: d_date = whybot.yellow_daily.trip_date (d_date_sk is TPC-DS only; no whybot view has it).
table_notes.NY_TAXI.yellow_taxi: Raw real TLC yellow trips (38.7M rows, all columns STRING, cast before arithmetic; pickup date = to_date(substr(tpep_pickup_datetime,1,10))). Uncached scan ~170 s: at most one narrow query. Contains outlier timestamps (2002, 2026).
table_notes.NY_TAXI.yellow_tripdata: DEV-ONLY sample: NYC TLC yellow taxi trips Jan-Feb 2024, one row per trip.
table_notes.NOAA_GHCN_S3.noaa_ghcn_daily_2024: DEV-ONLY sample: NOAA GHCN-Daily long format (ID station, DATE yyyymmdd int, ELEMENT PRCP tenths mm / SNOW mm / TMAX,TMIN tenths C, DATA_VALUE). Filter ID='USW00094728' (Central Park).

dialect_notes: Spark SQL functions: to_date(ts), date_format(d,'EEEE') for weekday name, dayofweek(d) returns 1=Sunday..7=Saturday (but TPCDS_DB.date_dim.d_dow is 0=Sunday..6=Saturday), to_date(CAST(x AS STRING),'yyyyMMdd') for yyyymmdd integers, date_add/datediff, CASE WHEN. Reference tables by their full two-part name exactly as listed under TABLES (e.g. whybot.yellow_daily). No semicolons. Prefer aggregated outputs (<200 rows). ZETARIS QUIRKS (verified): (1) never read the same whybot.* view twice in one query (no self-joins, no two CTEs over the same view): it fails with MISSING_ATTRIBUTES; compare target vs baseline with conditional aggregation instead, e.g. MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN trips END) AS target_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips, or simply return one row per date. Joining two DIFFERENT views on the date key is fine. (2) Compare dates with DATE 'yyyy-mm-dd' literals, never integers. date_add(d, n) takes 2 arguments. (3) An error like "mismatched input ... expecting {'ADD', 'ANALYZE', ...}" or "expecting 'METADATA'" means the statement failed to parse or resolve: simplify it, use only listed column names, and avoid short table aliases at the start of the select list. (4) Cross-source joins are on the date key, each view read once; this one is verified (sql/10, about 17 s for 62 days): SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, w.prcp_mm, w.snow_mm, h.holiday_name, d.d_day_name FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30' ORDER BY y.trip_date

hmem_recall.content: Investigation recorded-example-2-snow-saturday: Q='Did the snowfall on Saturday 21 Dec 2024 reduce NYC yellow taxi trips compared with the other Saturdays in December 2024, and why?' -> answered: Snowfall on 21 Dec 2024 had no material impact on NYC yellow taxi trips (supported: H3)

Investigation recorded-example-3-mlk-fare: Q='Why did the average total amount per yellow taxi trip jump on Monday 20 Jan 2025 compared with the other Mondays in January 2025?' -> answered: Yellow taxi trips on MLK Day 20 Jan 2025 averaged 36.5% higher total amount than other Mondays in January 2025 (supported: H0, H1)
Lesson: Join: linking yellow_daily to date_dim requires date_dim.date_key; verify the join key mapping before downstream filtering.
Lesson: Filter: always cross-check holiday status across us_holidays and TPCDS date_dim, as d_holiday flags may be stale or incorrect.

Lesson (SQL repair on whybot.yellow_daily, whybot.nyc_weather_daily, TPCDS_DB.date_dim): error 'Zetaris error: java.sql.SQLException: org.apache.hive.service.cli.HiveSQLException: com.zetaris.lightning.error.LightningException: <<<[UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_S' was fixed by: SELECT y.trip_date, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' AND d.d_dow = 1 THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips, w.prcp_mm, w.snow_mm, w.tmax_c, w.tmin_c FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON

calls.content:
{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips,
       AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21', DATE '2024-11-28')
GROUP BY y.trip_date
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Uses conditional aggregation to compute target trips and baseline average in a single pass. No self-joins or duplicate view reads. All dates referenced as DATE literals."
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date, 
       MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips,
       AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips,
       MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN h.holiday_name END) AS holiday_name
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date
JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date
WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY y.trip_date
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "whybot.us_holidays", "TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],
  "note": "Compares trips on 2024-11-28 (Thanksgiving) against all other days in Nov-Dec 2024; LEFT JOIN ensures days without a holiday still appear in results"
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date, 
       y.trips AS trips,
       y.avg_total_amount AS avg_total_amount,
       y.avg_trip_distance AS avg_trip_distance,
       CASE WHEN y.trips IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_null_trips,
       CASE WHEN ABS(y.trips - AVG(y.trips) OVER ()) > 3 * STDDEV(y.trips) OVER () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_outlier
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date
WHERE d.d_dow = 4
  AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],
  "note": "Baseline Thursday analysis for Nov-Dec 2024; outlier detection uses window functions over the same period"
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS target_avg_trip_distance,
       MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS target_avg_total_amount,
       AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' AND d.d_dow = 1 THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_trip_distance,
       AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' AND d.d_dow = 1 THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_total_amount
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date
WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30'
GROUP BY y.trip_date
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],
  "note": "Baseline restricted to Thursdays (d.d_dow = 1) to compare 28 Nov 2024 against surrounding Thursdays."
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       y.avg_trip_distance,
       y.avg_total_amount,
       CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN 'target' ELSE 'baseline' END AS day_type
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21', DATE '2024-11-28')
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "One row per requested date showing avg_trip_distance, avg_total_amount, and day_type flag (target vs baseline)."
}
